Play Ship of Fools locally with three people!

### Install

Download **Ship-of-Fools-3-Player-Mod-0.4.0.zip** below. Close the game, extract
everything into the game's folder, then double-click **Install.cmd**.
No extra software needed. Use the named mod ZIP, not the Source code download.

### Play

Join two players and choose characters as usual. Once on the island, press a
face button on the spare gamepad. The third character appears beside player two.
Use three gamepads, or a keyboard/mouse and two gamepads.

Players two and three share the inventory on the right. Your inventory button
shows your own items; either player can take over the panel.

### Please note

This is an experimental local-play mod for the supported Windows Steam version.
Some menus still support two players. Player three starts as a copy of player
two, and their items aren't saved separately. Put valuable items on the ship
before changing areas or quitting.

This release focuses on three-player co-op and keeps the previous inventory and
saving fixes. To remove it, close the game and double-click **Uninstall.cmd**.
